mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my exterior renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves several key steps. Look for licensed and insured professionals with a strong portfolio of exterior renovation projects similar to yours. Check their references, read online reviews, and ensure they have a clear communication process. Request detailed written estimates that outline the scope of work, materials, timeline, and payment schedule. A reputable contractor will also discuss necessary permits and offer warranties on their work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor who is licensed, insured, has relevant experience, good references, clear communication, and provides detailed written estimates and warranties.
